title: A terminal preorder bar contracts to its value
statement: Let I be a preorder and A a preadditive category with a zero object and coproducts in the universes of I and Nat. Let j∈I satisfy i≤j for every i, and let D:I→CochainComplex(A,Int). The canonical total bar augmentation to D(j) [def-sc-preorder-bar-total] has an explicitly constructed homotopy inverse. When A is abelian, the augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: Include D(j) in every simplicial degree using the constant string at j. This section followed by augmentation is identity. In the other order its composite is the reindexing induced by the constant order map i↦j and the unit i≤j, so the unit prism supplies a homotopy. Apply the alternating face-map functor and totalize the homotopy equivalence. The constant simplicial object contracts to the single column by Mathlib ExtraDegeneracy.const; finally use the actual single-column collapse isomorphism. The composite hom map is exactly the canonical augmentation.
